title: Collateral Concentration Table — Units Remaining Pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Loan
content:
**Rule.** The post-release margin of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is narrowed by how few units remain pledged: 8 points are taken off when a single unit remains, 4 points when two units remain, and nothing when three or more remain.

| Units remaining pledged on the test date | Points to the post-release margin |
|---|---|
| one | -8 |
| two | -4 |
| three or more | none |

**Counting.** The units remaining pledged are those pledged to the loan less those since released, the unit released that day among the released.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- A loan that held three units and released one on sale today has two remaining: 4 points come off the margin.
- A loan that held two units and released one after a total loss has a single unit remaining: 8 points come off.
- A loan with four units remaining after a release: no change to the margin.
